instructions: Curate ONLY verified hackathons with genuine official registration links.

Every entry below was verified against its official source on 2026-11-16 AND re-checked later the same day (registration still open at check time). Deadlines without a published time use documented conventions/conversions noted per entry.

Registration status MUST be re-confirmed in a browser ON THE DAY OF --apply — deadlines move. An entry whose registration has closed by then must be removed or its deadline/status recorded as closed, never inserted as Open.

Final pre-publication verification (2026-11-16, later same day): all 12 application URLs were loaded directly in a browser. Devfolio/Devpost/T-Hub/HFT/official sites confirmed via page content; all three Unstop listings and the HackIndia page were rendered in-browser and their deadlines read verbatim from the live pages (see curation_notes). Unstop/HackIndia listings remain the highest-churn — re-confirm on day of --apply.

Entries with registration_deadline: null are stored with registration_status 'Unknown' — the UI must NOT imply registration is open for them (see hackathon-status.ts / calculateRegistrationStatus). They carry no claim that registration is open; the Apply link points at the official registration page, which is the source of truth.
Pending-verification entries (Innodata, Algo Trading, Mantrastra) were moved to seeds/hackathons.pending.json on 2026-11-16 and are NOT to be seeded until re-verified in a browser.
allow_expired: true publishes the event as Closed (hidden by default, never deleted).
